business_problem: One Mount Group needed to replace legacy product platforms with a scalable, secure, real-time microservices architecture and lacked the internal capacity to build and operate change-data-capture pipelines across its growing ecosystem.
solution_summary: One Mount Group rebuilt core parts of its technology stack around a microservices architecture backed by Confluent Platform on Google Cloud. The first implementation used pub/sub messaging to power a payment gateway with near-real-time transaction processing between customer channels and backend services. The second major use case used Kafka Connect and Schema Registry to implement CDC across heterogeneous systems including MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Cloud SQL, MongoDB, SAP, and Salesforce, giving teams one resilient streaming layer instead of bespoke point integrations. By self-managing Confluent Platform and extending it with a custom Terraform provider, the company gained the flexibility to fit its own integration requirements while lowering the effort required to launch new services and data pipelines across VinID, VinShop, and other platforms.

solution_components.name: Confluent Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the central event-streaming platform for One Mount Group's payment and CDC workloads.

solution_components.name: Kafka Connect
solution_components.role: Captures and moves changes from operational systems into the shared streaming architecture.

solution_components.name: Schema Registry
solution_components.role: Standardizes event contracts so teams can build CDC and microservices integrations faster.

data_flow: Customer transactions and source-system changes flow into Confluent Platform through pub/sub and CDC pipelines, where Kafka Connect and Schema Registry normalize events before backend services and downstream product teams consume them across the broader One Mount ecosystem.
business_outcome: One Mount Group cut streaming integration effort, launched its microservices platform faster, and gained a stable, secure data foundation that supports payment processing and future innovation across its digital ecosystem.
architecture_clues: One Mount self-manages Confluent Platform on Google Cloud for flexibility and customization.
The team built a custom Terraform provider to fit its integration requirements.
The initial rollout covered both payment pub/sub and CDC streaming across multiple databases and business systems.
